note: Queries checked on both engines for the same results (docs/benchmarks.md, section "The DAX engine bench"). Model measures: xtask/src/engine_bench.rs (MEASURES). Every query has a full ORDER BY, or a single row, so both engines return the rows in the same order. Kinds are the visual each query stands for.

queries.title: Total ROW(SUM)
queries.dax: EVALUATE ROW("CA", [CA])

queries.title: Three totals and COUNTROWS
queries.dax: EVALUATE ROW("CA", [CA], "Qte", [Qte], "Lignes", COUNTROWS(Ventes))

queries.title: SUMMARIZECOLUMNS by category
queries.dax: EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(Produit[Categorie], "CA", [CA]) ORDER BY Produit[Categorie]

queries.title: SUMMARIZECOLUMNS by month (60 months)
queries.dax: EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(Calendrier[AnneeMois], "CA", [CA], "Qte", [Qte]) ORDER BY Calendrier[AnneeMois]

queries.title: Store × category (2,000 cells)
queries.dax: EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(Magasin[Magasin], Produit[Categorie], "CA", [CA]) ORDER BY Magasin[Magasin], Produit[Categorie]

queries.title: DISTINCTCOUNT of the customer
queries.dax: EVALUATE ROW("Clients", [Nb clients])

queries.title: DISTINCTCOUNT of the customer by region
queries.dax: EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(Magasin[Region], "Clients", [Nb clients]) ORDER BY Magasin[Region]

queries.title: CALCULATE with a dimension filter
queries.dax: EVALUATE ROW("CA", CALCULATE([CA], Produit[Categorie] = "Cat03"))

queries.title: TREATAS (Desktop's slicer form)
queries.dax: DEFINE VAR __DS0FilterTable = TREATAS({"Cat01", "Cat02"}, Produit[Categorie]) VAR __DS0FilterTable2 = TREATAS({2024}, Calendrier[Annee]) EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(Magasin[Region], __DS0FilterTable, __DS0FilterTable2, "CA", [CA], "Qte", [Qte]) ORDER BY Magasin[Region]

queries.title: Year to date (TOTALYTD) by month of 2024
queries.dax: DEFINE VAR __DS0FilterTable = TREATAS({2024}, Calendrier[Annee]) EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(Calendrier[AnneeMois], __DS0FilterTable, "CA", [CA], "CA YTD", [CA YTD]) ORDER BY Calendrier[AnneeMois]

queries.title: Last year (SAMEPERIODLASTYEAR) by year
queries.dax: EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(Calendrier[Annee], "CA", [CA], "CA N-1", [CA N-1], "Var", [CA Var N-1]) ORDER BY Calendrier[Annee]

queries.title: Share of total (DIVIDE, ALL) by category
queries.dax: EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(Produit[Categorie], "CA", [CA], "Part", [Part CA]) ORDER BY Produit[Categorie]

queries.title: RANKX over the 1,000 products
queries.dax: EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(Produit[Produit], "CA", [CA], "Rang", [Rang produit]) ORDER BY Produit[Produit]

queries.title: TOPN 10 products
queries.dax: EVALUATE TOPN(10, SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(Produit[Produit], "CA", [CA]), [CA], DESC, Produit[Produit], ASC) ORDER BY [CA] DESC, Produit[Produit]

queries.title: FILTER over the fact (SUMX)
queries.dax: EVALUATE ROW("CA gros paniers", SUMX(FILTER(Ventes, Ventes[Quantite] >= 8), Ventes[Montant]))

queries.title: Row-by-row SUMX with RELATED
queries.dax: EVALUATE ROW("CA catalogue", SUMX(Ventes, Ventes[Quantite] * RELATED(Produit[PrixCatalogue])))

queries.title: Table by customer (high cardinality, Desktop's TOPN 501)
queries.dax: EVALUATE TOPN(501, SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(Ventes[ClientKey], "CA", [CA]), [CA], DESC, Ventes[ClientKey], ASC) ORDER BY [CA] DESC, Ventes[ClientKey]

queries.title: Active customers in 2024 (COUNTROWS of a grouping)
queries.dax: EVALUATE ROW("Clients actifs 2024", COUNTROWS(CALCULATETABLE(SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(Ventes[ClientKey], "CA", [CA]), Calendrier[Annee] = 2024)))

queries.title: Region × year with subtotals (ROLLUPADDISSUBTOTAL)
queries.dax: EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(ROLLUPADDISSUBTOTAL(Magasin[Region], "TotalRegion"), Calendrier[Annee], "CA", [CA]) ORDER BY [TotalRegion] DESC, Magasin[Region], Calendrier[Annee]

queries.title: AVERAGEX of sales by store
queries.dax: EVALUATE ROW("CA moyen par magasin", AVERAGEX(VALUES(Magasin[Magasin]), [CA]))

queries.title: Filter on a fact column (KEEPFILTERS) by subcategory
queries.dax: DEFINE VAR __DS0FilterTable = FILTER(KEEPFILTERS(VALUES(Ventes[Quantite])), Ventes[Quantite] > 5) EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(Produit[SousCategorie], __DS0FilterTable, "CA", [CA]) ORDER BY Produit[SousCategorie]

queries.title: MIN / MAX of the fact's date
queries.dax: EVALUATE ROW("Premiere", MIN(Ventes[Date]), "Derniere", MAX(Ventes[Date]))
